description: List the workflow transitions available from a Jira issue's current status (id/name/to_status). Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the list finishing; the available transitions are delivered when the job completes. Read action.
embedding_description: Discover which workflow moves are currently available for a Jira issue, given its present state and project workflow -- each transition's id, name, and target status. Returns a job_id right away and lands the options list once the background lookup completes. Call it to choose a transition id before moving an issue.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the transitions list -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the listing was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what transitions are available'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the transitions list lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the available moves and their target statuses so the caller can pick a transition id for transition_issue. This is workflow metadata (low sensitivity).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the transitions available from a Jira issue's current status.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.not_found: the issue key does not exist. jira.permission_denied: the account cannot view the issue. jira.invalid_params: the key was missing.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.not_found: verify the issue key. jira.permission_denied: grant the service account browse permission. jira.invalid_params: supply the issue key.
